display.purpose: H1–H3 headings only; never body copy.

body.purpose: All running copy, labels, nav, form fields.

shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: Resting elevation for the primary button and the proof-section photo.

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: Hover state for buttons; resting state of the hero photo and nav dropdown.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default easing for all hover/transition states across buttons, rows, and reveals.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call-to-action across the site (Demander un devis, Envoyer ma demande).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #b91f2c; color: #fff9f5; padding: 0.85rem 1.5rem; border-radius: 6px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.95rem; border: none; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(33,28,20,0.05), 0 14px 32px -18px rgba(33,28,20,0.28); transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), background-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #8c1620; transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgba(33,28,20,0.08), 0 20px 40px -20px rgba(33,28,20,0.35); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b91f2c; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action (Toutes les prestations, Voir toute la galerie).
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #21201c; border: 1px solid #c9bda0; padding: 0.85rem 1.5rem; border-radius: 6px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.95rem; transition: border-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), background-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: #21201c; background: #fffdf9; }

components.name: Phone Pill
components.description: The always-visible emergency phone affordance in the header, hero, and CTA banners.
components.css: .ds-phone-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; background: #b91f2c; color: #fff9f5; padding: 0.6rem 1.05rem; border-radius: 999px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9rem; white-space: nowrap; transition: background-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); text-decoration: none; } .ds-phone-pill:hover { background: #8c1620; }

components.name: Service Row
components.description: Photo-led index row: signature replacement for the generic icon-card grid, used to list all eight trades.
components.html:
Travaux de couverture

Réfection, rénovation et création de toitures.

Découvrir
components.css: .ds-service-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 9.5rem 1fr auto; align-items: center; gap: 2rem; padding: 2rem 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #ddd3bd; text-decoration: none; color: inherit; transition: background-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-service-row:hover { background: #ece5d5; } .ds-service-row__media { width: 9.5rem; height: 7rem; border-radius: 6px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-service-row__media img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-service-row:hover .ds-service-row__media img { transform: scale(1.05); } .ds-service-row__go { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 600; color: #b91f2c; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Related Card
components.description: Small photo card linking to a related service, used at the bottom of every service detail page.
components.html:
Travaux de zinguerie

Solins & raccords →
components.css: .ds-related-card { display: block; border-radius: 6px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #ddd3bd; background: #fffdf9; transition: box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); text-decoration: none; color: inherit; } .ds-related-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(33,28,20,0.05), 0 14px 32px -18px rgba(33,28,20,0.28); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-related-card__media { aspect-ratio: 16/10; overflow: hidden; } .ds-related-card__media img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; } .ds-related-card__body { padding: 1rem 1.5rem; } .ds-related-card__body h4 { font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; margin: 0 0 0.25rem; } .ds-related-card__body span { font-size: 0.85rem; color: #b91f2c; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Form input/textarea/select used throughout the contact form.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.5rem; } .ds-field label { font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 600; color: #4a453c; } .ds-field input { border: 1px solid #c9bda0; border-radius: 3px; padding: 0.75rem 0.9rem; background: #fffdf9; color: #21201c; transition: border-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-field input:focus { border-color: #b91f2c; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #f7e6e2; outline: none; }

narrative.overview: Alpha Bâtiment is a multi-trade roofing, zinc-work, painting, insulation and facade contractor in rural Dordogne, and the site is built to read like the portfolio site of a small architecture studio that happens to also fix roofs — not like a stock WordPress contractor template. The system trades icon-circle soup, gradient hero banners, and animated counters (the previous site's visual vocabulary) for a warm stone-neutral canvas, one confident signal-red reserved for action and urgency, generous negative space, and real, unstaged job-site photography treated as the primary evidence of craft. The incumbent site (Elementor stock-photo template, icon grids, unset "+0" stat counters) is the explicit anti-reference. Every decision here pulls toward calm, factual trust — real photos, real coverage towns, one phone number always visible — rather than generic contractor-site trust theater.
keyCharacteristics: Warm stone-paper ground, near-black warm ink — never pure white or pure black.
One accent color (signal red) used exclusively for calls-to-action, urgency, and hover states; never decorative.
Space Grotesk display type paired with Inter body type: geometric confidence up top, high-legibility workhorse below.
Real job photography at large scale is the system's primary decoration; there is no stock photography and no icon-circle grid.
Thin 1px hairlines do the organizing work that shadows or card borders would do in a more decorative system.

rules.name: The One Red Rule
rules.body: Signal red appears only on things you can act on — a button, a phone number, an active nav state, a focus ring. It never appears as a background wash, a heading color, or a decorative flourish.

rules.name: The No-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Sections open straight into their H2; there is no small-caps kicker line above headings.

rules.name: The Hairline-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Lists, rows, and section boundaries are separated with a 1px hairline, never a card shadow. Shadows are reserved for the handful of surfaces that should feel physically lifted.

dos: Do use real, unstaged job-site photography at large scale as the primary visual interest of every section.
Do keep Signal Red reserved for actionable elements only.
Do separate lists and rows with 1px hairlines rather than card shadows or backgrounds.
Do keep body copy measure-constrained (~34rem) even inside wide containers.
Do keep the phone number visible in the header and in every page's closing CTA.
donts: Don't introduce icon-circle grids, gradient hero banners, or animated counters.
Don't add a small-caps eyebrow kicker above headings.
Don't invent statistics, testimonials, or certifications not confirmed by the business owner.
Don't use pure black or pure white anywhere.
